name: Tonari ni Kanojo no Iru Shiawase ~Two Farce~
original_name: となりに彼女のいる幸せ ～Two Farce～
source:
It won’t be long before the historic literature club will be disbanded as there’s just the protagonist and his kouhai Chisa left. Even as they worry about the club’s future, they carried on with their daily trivial exchanges in the club room together. And so, they became closer by the day.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/08/01/august-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
用不了多久，历史文学社就会解散，只剩下主角和他的后辈千纱了。两人一边为俱乐部的未来担忧，一边在俱乐部房间里继续着日常的琐事交流。就这样，他们的关系一天比一天亲近。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/08/01/august-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
